userdoc.notice: Contract for managing tokenized equity assetsThe GMTokenManager contract contains the core logic for processing minting         and redemptions of GM tokens.         The responsibilities of this contract are:          - Verifying attestation signatures          - Calculating the amount of GM tokens and USDon to mint and burn            based on the quote attestation that was received          - Performing appropriate sanity checks on the quote attestation          - Enforcing the minimum deposit and redemption amounts and ensuring the            quote price is in line with the rough oracle price          - Ensuring users are registered with the OndoIDRegistry          - Checking user-specific and global rate limits
